using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct step {
	ll val; int cost;
	bool operator<(const step &c) const {
		return c.cost < cost;
	}
};

set<ll> visited;

bool hasVisited(ll c) {
	return visited.count(c) > 0;
}

step getUpperBound(ll n){
	ll res = 0;
	int i = 0;
	while(res < n){
		res = res * 10 + 1;
		i++;
	}
	return {res, i};
}

step getUpper(ll n){
	ll res = 0;
	int i = 0;
	while(res * 10 + 1 <= n){
		res = res * 10 + 1;
		i++;
	}
	ll resmul = res;
	int imul = i;
	while(res < n){
		res += resmul;
		i += imul;
	}
	return {res, i};
}

step getLower(ll n){
	ll res = 0;
	int i = 0;
	while(res * 10 + 1 <= n){
		res = res * 10 + 1;
		i++;

	ll resmul = res;
	int imul = i;
	while(res + resmul <= n){
		res += resmul;
		i += imul;
	}
	return {res, i};

int main() {

	cin >> n;

	priority_queue<step> pq;

	pq.push({n, 0});

	while(pq.top().val != 0){
